name: Google Veo Cinematic Video Ingest Pipeline
purpose: Ingestion protocol for external generative video clips (Google Veo / Flow Web UI), normalizing them to 1280x720 30fps silent backgrounds.
capabilities: Automated resolution and framerate normalization via ingest-asset.sh
Layering under SVG vector stage with vignette blending

installation.instructions: Place raw mp4 in assets/generated/ and run ./scripts/ingest-asset.sh <file>.

compatibility.notes: Produces silent H.264 MP4s compatible with HyperFrames.

licensing.notes: Generated video assets under user license.

security.notes: Local file normalization and asset placement.

approval_evidence: Production certified in Stage 7 cinematic blending.
